title: The Gold Myth That Drains Long-Term Wealth

beats.say: Holding gold for 20 years lost buyers nearly 80% against inflation between 1980 and 2000.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of a heavy gold bullion bar resting on cold, wet concrete under a single sodium light.

beats.say: That shiny metal sits in a vault while everyday prices climb higher each year.
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a massive steel bank vault door reflecting dim, flickering fluorescent light.

beats.say: So why do millions still trust gold as the ultimate safe-haven wealth builder?
beats.visual: Silhouette of a person standing alone on a foggy rooftop edge against a dark, industrial skyline.

beats.say: Most assume precious metals protect your purchasing power better than anything else on earth.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of an empty highway cutting through a dark, rain-slick mountain pass at blue hour.

beats.say: That is the head fake. Unproductive commodities actually drag down long-term portfolio growth.
beats.visual: Macro shot of rusty iron chains resting on damp asphalt under harsh overhead sodium lighting.

beats.say: Because gold produces zero cash flow, dividends, or earnings to compound over time.
beats.visual: High angle shot of a solitary metal storage locker in a vast, dark, empty warehouse.

beats.say: How much does that missed compounding actually cost your future net worth?
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of dark water droplets falling onto a cold, metallic surface in shadow.

beats.say: If you invest $500 a month at 8% a year, it grows to $1,745,504 in 40 years.
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a heavy steel suspension bridge tower cutting through thick, cold fog.

beats.say: Gold generates none of those compounding returns while sitting quietly in your safe.
beats.visual: Macro shot of a heavy iron padlock hanging on a dark, weathered wooden door in deep shadow.

beats.say: What happens when you swap dead metal for income-producing assets that work for you?
beats.visual: Silhouette of a lone worker walking across a vast, wet industrial rail yard at twilight.

beats.say: You replace a stagnant hedge with productive systems that compound your cash every single month.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a massive container port under cold, blue-hour security lighting.

beats.say: Stop hiding cash in commodities that bleed purchasing power.
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a towering concrete bridge pier slick with persistent evening rain.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: Single warm practical light cutting through absolute darkness on an empty rural road.

caption: Gold looks safe, but it destroys your purchasing power over time. Here is the math that changes everything. #money #personalfinance #wealth #investing #gold
